messages:
emma: Quick sync — micro-experiment proposal: test two starter credit sizes (50 vs 150) + a 20-min onboarding mini-webinar. Objective: activation velocity (time to 3 meaningful sessions) + inbound routing lift. Run length: 2 weeks. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

raj: +1. Hypothesis: 150 credits -> faster activation but could reduce LTV. Metrics to track: time_to_3_sessions, 7d retention, demo_book_rate, downstream paid conversion. Also cohort by signup_source and credit_variant.

lena: I'll draft two invite copies: one focused on "150 starter credits + live quickstart", the other "50 credits + curated prompt templates." Will prep 3 prompt templates (summarize, semantic-search, chatflow starter).

michael: Baseline time_to_3_sessions (median) is ~48h. Quick estimate: 50 credits -> ~30% faster, 150 -> ~60% faster. I'll wire experiment flags, split buckets, and a dashboard. Draft query: https://dash.company.com/q/exp123

noah: Routing idea — credit >= 100 -> inbound-sdr-high queue, else -> nurture-self-serve. Add rule: if user runs >3 model calls in first 24h, create high-touch alert (contact SLA 6h).

emma: Good call. mic, can you add tracking for `first_run_with_template` boolean? lena, plz drop prompt files + quick how-to in Drive. raj, you'll own ramp criteria (stat sig thresholds + scale plan). :pray:

michael: On it. I created experiment buckets and a draft dashboard. Tagging: exp_id=miniweb-credits-2067. ETA: queries + sample export by EOD tomorrow.

lena: Uploaded drafts to Drive: /marketing/miniwebinar/copies_v1.md and /marketing/miniwebinar/prompt_templates_v1.json. I added short notes for subject lines and 3 CTAs.

emma: Suggested routing config snippet for infra/dev to implement:
```
route_rule:
  - if: signup.credit_grant >= 100
    to: inbound-sdr-high
  - else:
    to: nurture-self-serve
fallback: https://redwood.com/miniwebinar-recording
```

raj: Plan: Week 1 = A/B subject lines x credit_size (50 vs 150). Week 2 = scale winner, keep 5% holdout to measure long-term conversion. Success criteria: 20% uplift in time_to_3_sessions and >10% lift in demo_book_rate without >15% drop in 30d retention.

noah: I'll create the 'inbound-sdr-high' queue in SF and map the experiment flag to lead_source=miniweb-credits-2067. Also adding tag: priority=high.

emma: Nice. Action items summarized: michael = experiment infra + dashboard, lena = copy + templates, raj = ramp gating + analysis plan, noah = SF routing + queue. Sync: Fri 11:00 for final go/no-go. :calendar: :rocket:
